title: Massively Parallel Diagnosis and Genome Sequencing of SARS-CoV-2
author: Leigh G Monahan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.betrjem6

steps.title: Wash streptavidin Dynabeads
steps.instruction: Wash 200 µL of Dynabeads™ MyOne™ C1 magnetic beads according to the manufacturer: vortex the bead vial >30 s, transfer 200 µL beads to a tube, add 200 µL 1X B&W buffer, resuspend, place on a magnet for 1 min, discard supernatant; repeat the magnet‑wash cycle two more times for a total of three washes, then pellet beads and resuspend in 400 µL 2X B&W buffer.

steps.title: Immobilise barcoded oligo on beads
steps.instruction: For each unique barcode, add 40 µL of 5 µM biotin‑spacer‑partial Illumina p5‑adapter‑barcode‑stub oligonucleotide to 40 µL washed beads, incubate 15 min at room temperature with gentle rotation, separate beads with a magnet for 2–3 min, wash 2–3 times with 100 µL 1X B&W buffer, and finally resuspend the coated beads in 120 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Generate bead‑bound probe libraries (Pool 1 & 2)
steps.instruction: For each barcode set up two separate 0.2 mL PCR tubes (Pool 1 and Pool 2). To each tube add: 60 µL bead‑bound template, 20 µL 5X PrimeSTAR GXL buffer, 8 µL 2.5 mM dNTP mix, 10 µL 10 µM SARS‑CoV‑2 probe pool 1 (or pool 2), and 2 µL PrimeSTAR GXL DNA polymerase. Run the reaction: 98 °C 10 s, 55 °C 15 s, 68 °C 2 min, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove non‑biotinylated strand
steps.instruction: Pellet beads on a magnet, wash once with 50 µL 1X SSC, resuspend in 20 µL freshly prepared 0.15 M NaOH and incubate 10 min at room temperature, pellet beads, discard supernatant, wash sequentially with 50 µL 0.1 M NaOH, 50 µL 1X B&W buffer, and 50 µL TE buffer, then resuspend beads in 50 µL TE buffer.

steps.title: Prepare clinical RNA samples
steps.instruction: Collect nasopharyngeal swabs in 1.5 mL transport medium (e.g., UTM, lysis/binding buffer, or a mixture). Optionally use kit‑extracted RNA or synthetic control RNA. Quantify 10 µL of swab diluent with the Qubit RNA HS assay (or equivalent).

steps.title: Hybridise RNA to bead‑bound probes
steps.instruction: For each sample, transfer 25 µL of the appropriate barcoded beads (one set per probe pool) into a 0.2 mL PCR tube (or multi‑well plate; scale volumes for 384‑well plates). Pellet beads, discard supernatant, add 50 µL swab diluent (or control RNA in 1X SSC) and resuspend by pipetting. Incubate in a pre‑heated thermal cycler at 75 °C for 2 min, then ramp to 25 °C at –0.1 °C s⁻¹. Pellet beads, discard supernatant, and resuspend each reaction in 20 µL Washing buffer A.

steps.title: Pool and wash bead samples
steps.instruction: Combine all “Pool 1” bead reactions into a fresh tube (repeat for “Pool 2”). Wash each pooled bead sample once with an equal volume of Washing buffer A, then twice with an equal volume of Washing buffer B, using a magnet between washes. After the final wash, keep beads suspended in Washing buffer B at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare reverse‑transcriptase master mix
steps.instruction: Combine the following (SuperScript™ IV First‑Strand Synthesis System): 20 µL 5X SSIV buffer, 5 µL 10 mM dNTP mix, 5 µL 100 mM DTT, 5 µL RNase inhibitor (40 U µL⁻¹), and 60 µL DEPC‑treated water (total 100 µL).

steps.title: Reverse transcription on beads
steps.instruction: Pellet the pooled beads, discard supernatant, pulse‑spin 5 s, place on magnet and discard any residual Washing buffer B. Add 25 µL of the RT master mix to the beads, discard the supernatant, then add 19 µL RT master mix plus 1 µL SuperScript™ IV Reverse Transcriptase (200 U µL⁻¹). Mix, incubate 55 °C for 10 min, then 80 °C for 10 min to inactivate. Pellet beads, discard supernatant, and wash once with TE buffer.

steps.title: First‑round PCR library amplification
steps.instruction: Pellet the cDNA‑coated beads from each pool and resuspend each in 28 µL nuclease‑free water. Set up PCR (per pool) with: 26.7 µL bead suspension, 10 µL 5X Q5 reaction buffer, 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 2.5 µL Illumina P5 index primer (10 µM), 9.3 µL SARS‑CoV‑2 primer pool 1 (or 2, 10 µM), and 0.5 µL Q5 Hot‑Start High‑Fidelity Polymerase. PCR program: 98 °C 30 s; 25‑35 cycles of 98 °C 15 s, 65 °C 5 min; hold 4 °C. Pellet beads and transfer the supernatant (amplified product) to a new tube.

steps.title: First‑round PCR cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a left‑side size selection using 1.2× volume SPRIselect beads according to the manufacturer’s protocol, then elute the purified library in 40 µL nuclease‑free water. Quantify 1 µL of the eluate with the Qubit dsDNA HS assay (or equivalent).

steps.title: Second‑round PCR to add adapters
steps.instruction: Set up PCR with 10 ng purified first‑round product, 10 µL 5X PrimeSTAR GXL buffer, 4 µL 2.5 mM dNTP mix, 1.25 µL Illumina P5 flow‑cell primer (10 µM), 1.25 µL Illumina P7 index primer (10 µM), 1 µL PrimeSTAR GXL DNA polymerase, and add nuclease‑free water to a final volume of 50 µL. PCR program: 98 °C 10 s; 6 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 60 °C 15 s, 68 °C 1 min; hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Second‑round PCR cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a left‑side size selection with 0.8× volume SPRIselect beads, elute in 40 µL nuclease‑free water, quantify with Qubit dsDNA HS assay, and assess fragment size distribution on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer (or similar). Calculate library molarity using: concentration (nM) = [ng µL⁻¹ / (660 g mol⁻¹ × average bp)] × 10⁶.

steps.title: Pool libraries and sequence
steps.instruction: Combine equimolar amounts of the final Pool 1 and Pool 2 libraries (and any additional libraries) based on the calculated molarity. Sequence the pooled library on an Illumina platform using 2 × 150 bp paired‑end reads.

steps.title: Alternative low‑cost bead preparation
steps.instruction: Repeat the bead‑washing steps (as in Step 1) and resuspend the final wash in 400 µL 2X B&W buffer. Immobilise a generic 5 µM biotinylated oligonucleotide (5′‑[Biotin][spacer][partial Illumina p5 adapter]‑3′) by adding 400 µL of the oligo to the 400 µL washed beads, incubate 15 min at room temperature with gentle rotation, magnet for 2–3 min, wash 2–3 times with 1X B&W buffer, and resuspend in 1.200 mL nuclease‑free water. For each barcode generate two probe libraries using a barcoded linker: in a 0.2 mL PCR tube combine 60 µL bead‑bound template, 20 µL 5X PrimeSTAR GXL buffer, 8 µL 2.5 mM dNTP mix, 5 µL 10 µM barcoded linker, 5 µL 10 µM SARS‑CoV‑2 probe pool 1 (or 2), and 2 µL PrimeSTAR GXL polymerase. Run: 98 °C 10 s, 55 °C 15 s, 68 °C 2 min, hold 4 °C. Then perform the strand‑removal steps identical to Step 4 (SSC wash, 0.15 M NaOH denaturation, sequential NaOH/B&W/TE washes, final resuspension in 50 µL TE).
